added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: the working route that does not go through dbsvr17p is asserted from a failed getent lookup plus static disassembly; the fragment reverse lookup of 192.168.29.13 also exits 2, so a reader cannot distinguish a bypass of dbsvr17p from that host under another address, and the done-when item is met only as named.

follow-on: the receipt log path is inside the run envelope and not committed, so a report-envelope GC leaves the cited path unopenable; the fragment states the receipt is embedded above as the durable copy.

follow-on: DBSEL is identified from source inspection only, and /analysis/bin/dbsel is not reconciled with the /analysis/bin/il SHOT TIME spelling pending in the plan section comment that mentions DBSEL, so a reader cannot tell whether they are one tool or two.

item_verdicts.diff: read c1308340..c00f9f05 commit by commit; one commit, one file, +154 lines, no source or test file changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the fragment lists all eleven eSurf DB ids with FLEDD route and one per-id Eqlist_Get_Rev return code (esurf-dbsel-trace-calls-table), locates DBSEL at /analysis/bin/dbsel, names the FAME socket route and records no credential.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to trace eSurf's equilibrium database access and DBSEL on nakasvr26; docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace.html:1-154 delivers it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, records commit c00f9f05, the eleven-call receipt command and its landing line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace.html and docs/figures/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace; the diff touches only the first.

justifications.durability: the fragment is committed at c00f9f05, but the receipt it names (fledd-calls-valid.log) lives only in the run envelope; the embedded call code and IRET table keep the record reproducible.
justifications.evidence: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace.html carries a positive control (FAME id 0 IRET=0 NLIST=5) and negative controls (invalid FAME_HOST/FAME_DIR unchanged), but the socket hop rests on objdump because the runtime strace was refused (fame-route.log), so it is inferred, not traced.
justifications.fit: every element id in docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace.html begins with the node id, the landing is a manifest line rather than a plan edit, and no plan or sprint identifier appears in the file.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace.html:1-154 lists all eleven DB ids, routes and per-id IRET, and locates DBSEL, but the done-when route "that does not go through dbsvr17p" is named yet its identity is left unresolved, so the deliverable is met as named rather than proven.
justifications.reuse: no production code is added so no capability is forked; the id/name enum re-read from edas_enum.py duplicates mapping knowledge the plan says is already ingested (database_api/edas_fledd_api.py eqdb_enumtype) without reconciling the two.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff c1308340..c00f9f05 touches only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/esurf-dbsel-trace.html (+154) and nothing else.
